author: Arachadonic
body:
I think it might be a neat idea to have the top three players in a match and the amount of kills they have to appear when a game ends in Nexus or Nebula. It would provide a greater  sense of competitiveness and I think would just be a cool feature. I have seen it done before so it is possible.
Thanks.
